prose.subject: URGENT: Updated Payout Details for Invoice INV-79721
prose.body:
Hi Rafael,

Hope you’re having a productive week. I’m writing to confirm that our treasury team has migrated our primary NEAR payment routing to a new consolidated account effective immediately. This change is part of our quarterly security audit to reduce latency in cross-chain settlements.

Please ensure that the pending payment for invoice INV-79721 (4538.86 USDC) is directed to our new dedicated payout address: cobaltfreeight35.testnet. The previous address will be deprecated at the end of the business day, so please prioritize this transfer to avoid automatic rejection by our settlement gateway.

I have attached the updated remittance notice for your records. If you can process this before 17:00 UTC, we can confirm receipt and close the invoice cycle for this month on our end. Our finance department is standing by to reconcile the transaction once it hits the explorer.

Thank you for your quick turnaround on this. Let me know if you run into any issues with the new address format.

Best regards,

Felix Castell
Senior Accounts Payable Manager
Cobalt Freight
